# Install libraries

```{r}
library(rjags)
load.module("wiener")
library(dplyr)
```

# Read Files

```{r}
base_dir = "C:/Users/Brian Kim/Documents/OneDrive - Drexel University/Documents/classes/cognew/Neuroethics/IndividualDifferenceRiskBenefit/DATA_ANALYSIS"
behavior_path = paste(base_dir, "/data/Cleaned_Pilot/exclusions.2020.10.21.Rdata", sep="")
load(behavior_path)
risk_data = Neuroethics_Judgement
```

# Transform Data

```{r}
risk_data <- risk_data %>% 
  # filter(rt <= 5000) %>% 
  mutate(rt = rt / 1000)


# Assuming risk_data is your dataframe
risk_data <- risk_data %>%
  mutate(
    response = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0),
    RT = if_else(response == 0, -rt, rt), # Multiply by -1 if response is 0
    risk = risk * 0.01,                   # Scale risk by 0.01
    gain = gain * 0.01,                    # Scale gain by 0.01
    no_effect = no_effect * 0.01
  )

# This will assign a unique index to each different 'subj_idx'
risk_data$idxP <- as.numeric(as.factor(risk_data$user_id))
```

# Run the stDDM

```{r}

chen_folder = paste(base_dir, '/analysis/timeDDM/Chen-2021', sep='')
scripts_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/Model fitting', sep='')  
results_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/ModelResults/Neuroethics', sep='')


idxP = risk_data$idxP

hd = (risk_data$gain) # gain probability
td = (risk_data$risk) # risk probability

rtpos = risk_data$rt

y= risk_data$RT

N = length(y)
ns = length(unique(idxP))

#--------------------------------------------
# fit the model

dat <- list(N=N, y=y, idxP=idxP, hd=hd, td=td, rt=rtpos, ns=ns)


inits3 <- list( alpha.mu=2, alpha.pr=0.05,  time.mu=0.5, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.1,
                            theta.pr=0.05,  b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.01, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.4,
                            bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Super-Duper", .RNG.seed=99999)


inits2 <- list( alpha.mu=2.2, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=-0.1, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.01,
                            theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.1, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.5,
                            bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Wichmann-Hill", .RNG.seed=1234)

inits1 <- list( alpha.mu=2.4, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=0, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.15,
                            theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.1, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.05, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.3,
                            bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y, .RNG.name="base::Mersenne-Twister", .RNG.seed=6666 )

monitor = c(
  "b1.mu", "b2.mu", "theta.mu", "alpha.mu","bias.mu","time.mu", "b1.p", "time.pr","time", "b2.p",  "theta.p", "bias","alpha.p", "deviance", "ld_comp" )


model.fit = jags.model(file="tssmHT_model_priors_M1.txt", data=dat, inits=list(inits1, inits2, inits3), n.chains=3)

model.samples = coda.samples(model.fit, monitor, n.iter=10000)

results = summary(window(model.samples, start=5000))

# save(results,data, file=paste(c(file.path(results_folder,"results_neuroethics_with_trial"), ".RData"), collapse = ""))
# write.csv(suuum, file=paste(c(file.path(results_folder,"results_neuroethics_with_trial"), ".csv"), collapse = "") ) 
```
